title: The census of Classical Philology, 1906–2026: the Crossref records, the items kept, the samples for the blind run, the corpus-grain candidates read by hand, the script and the working notebook
edition: Built in session, 16 November 2026, from Crossref metadata

license.payload: Crossref metadata as served (Crossref states its metadata open, CC0). Crossref holds no abstracts for this journal (0 of 11,206); none is seated. The items, samples, codes, script and notebook are the archive's, CC-BY-4.0.
license.record: CC-BY-4.0 applies to this seat record only.

works.units: one text file per volume or work

list.work: the census and its working files

normalization: As built by census_cp.py (held under original/): the raw Crossref response is recorded by its SHA-256 and not reseated; the works list keeps DOI, year, type, title, subtitle, authors, volume, issue, page and citation count.
scope: Every file the notebook's tables and samples are built from.
why_seated: So that every figure in the notebook (§§1, 4) can be rebuilt from what is seated, and the blind parallel run joined to the sample by its ids.
ruling: Lee Sharks, 2026-11-16: "oh - and we need an ea-corpora. what can and should be gathered up? philology is a rich historical field"; "first we check what we have"; "lets begin gathering for the ea corpora"; "certainly we can locate wilamowitz elsewhere... and Nietzsche - there must be copies"; 14:48 EST: "and then yes lets build the ea-corpora deposit".

research.study: The Philology Census: Classical Philology first (working notebook v0.1, not deposited), the combined audit's next station after #1770 and #1773
research.for: the census of Classical Philology read on the page and not only in its titles (notebook §4, limits; §5.3), and the constitution of philology, its method, its boundary and its standing question, against which the census's codes are read
